question: Which of the following companies owns KUKA Robotics (Industrial Robots)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Midea Group, China**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Midea Group, China** owns KUKA Robotics, a leading manufacturer of industrial robots.
 
• KUKA Robotics is known for providing innovative automation solutions for various industries, including automotive, electronics, and healthcare.
 
• The acquisition of KUKA by Midea Group was completed in 2016, significantly expanding Midea's capabilities in automation and robotics.
 
• Midea Group is a Chinese electrical appliance manufacturer, and its acquisition of KUKA highlights the growing influence of Chinese companies in the global technology and manufacturing sectors.
 
• KUKA's products and solutions are utilized worldwide, contributing to increased efficiency and productivity in manufacturing processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **KUKA** was founded in 1898 and has its headquarters in Augsburg, Germany.
 
• The company specializes in industrial robots and solutions for factory automation.
 
• **Midea Group** was established in 1968 and is one of the largest producers of consumer appliances in China.
 
• The acquisition of KUKA is part of Midea's strategy to diversify and enhance its technological capabilities beyond traditional consumer appliances.
 
• The collaboration between Midea and KUKA aims to drive advancements in smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
